source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Αυξέντιος ο εν Καρτιλίω ασκήσας»

attestations.note: His page makes him spiritual father to Patriarch Cyril V of Constantinople and the leader of the party that held for the rebaptism of converts, and says his memory is kept with splendour at Stavros in Chalkidiki, where a portion of his relic was carried in 1922 by refugees uprooted from Asia Minor.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε στην Άνδρο στις αρχές του 18ου αιώνα μ.Χ.» — the page gives the quarter-century and no year, and the interval is that and no more. It gives no year for his death.
